description: This file defines a utility enum `GatewayEndpointID` with static functions for generating stable identifiers and pretty descriptions for Network (`NWEndpoint`) objects, particularly handling service endpoints and escaping/normalizing service names.

methods.name: stableID
methods.description: Generates a stable string identifier for a given `NWEndpoint`, especially for service types, ensuring stability across encoding differences.

methods.name: prettyDescription
methods.description: Provides a human-readable description for an `NWEndpoint`, applying custom decoding for service endpoints.

methods.name: normalizeServiceNameForID
methods.description: Decodes a service name and normalizes whitespace, trimming extra spaces and newlines to produce a stable service name string.
